recipe: Inherit unchanged book data, four sites, frozen base, MPS f32, eager no-cache, batch2, 512 steps, AdamW 0.001 linear schedule and clip0.1
treatment: Only promote the existing four log_radius buffers to trainable parameters, using the existing Rust VJP and the same HF optimizer group rules
fixed_replay_gate: All six fixed-control final artifact IDs and CE must exactly reproduce the published book outcomes
initial_gate: Same output and common gate/bias gradients within each fixed/learned pair; initial log_radius gradients exactly zero
resume_gate: Final artifacts, optimizer/scheduler/MPS RNG tensor states and HF RNG bytes equal uninterrupted runs
selection: No best checkpoint selection, adaptive learning rate, retries, dropped failures, new radius choice or automatic promotion
publication: All cases, metrics, failure dispositions, aggregate radius-change statistics, hashes and replay; corpus, generated text and individual learned weights remain local
